tools.name: medicare_get_physician_fee
tools.description: Use this when you need what Medicare's Physician Fee Schedule allows for a CPT or HCPCS code on a given date of service, for the nation or for one state or locality, in the office or facility setting. It takes up to 25 lines (code, modifier, date of service) and returns one answer per line, in order

tools.name: medicare_list_fee_releases
tools.description: Use this when you need to know which CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule releases the archive holds, with their effective dates, CMS source files, SHA-256 checksums and any gaps in coverage, before or instead of looking up a fee.
